Q. 3 اِفْرَنْبَجَ , said of a lamb, (Lth, O,) or of the skin of a lamb, (S, K, [some of the copies of
the latter of which have الجَمَل in the place of الحَمَل,]) and of the skin of a kid, (O,) It was roasted so that the upper parts of it became dried up. (Lth, S, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
